note: NECO Financial Accounting round 7 (R40 top-up): trade vs cash discount; returns inwards book; bad debts defined; bad debts recovered; going concern; dual aspect; business entity; prudence; money measurement; the partnership deed; equal sharing where no deed exists; dividends defined; interim dividend; ordinary shares; fixed assets; liabilities; debtors and creditors; capital vs revenue receipts; drawings. Scanned against the whole Accounting pool (WAEC and NECO stems).
